title: Term Life Insurance Waiver Rate Schedule by Issue Age — Waiver Removal Reckoning
content:
**Schedule.** In the Term Life Insurance waiver removal reckoning (the installment after the waiver of premium rider ends at its expiry age), the waiver rate is set by the insured's issue age, the whole years from the insured's date of birth to the issue date on record.

| Issue age | Waiver rate |
|---|---|
| below 35 | 0.09 |
| 35 through 44 | 0.11 |
| 45 or more | 0.14 |

Footnotes to the schedule:

1. The boundary ages 35 and 45 belong to the higher row: issue age 34 takes 0.09, 35 takes 0.11; issue age 44 takes 0.11, 45 takes 0.14.
2. The issue age is fixed by the dates on record and does not change as the insured grows older.
3. Hypothetical figure: a waiver charge base of 1000.00 at issue age 47 gives a waiver charge of 140.00; at issue age 31, 90.00.
